2024_167_jun_2024_pcard_report.paragraph: Purchasing-card activity for Troy School District covering charges posted for June 2024, printed 8/14/2024 with pages numbered through 24 and placed before the Board of Education for its August 20, 2024 meeting. Every line carries a transaction date, an abbreviated merchant name, the journal-entry description "JUN 2024 PCARD EXP," a budget unit, an account code, and an amount in either the Transaction Amount or the Credits column. The listing closes with a Subtotal of 359,974.64, Credits of 13,553.04, and Total Expenses of 346,421.60. The single largest charge is 12,765.00 to PAY*YMCA CAM on 6/7/2024 in budget unit 700011199900600.
